notes: ACCESS: direct fetch throughout via the shared probe harness (curl_cffi); no WAF, no proxy, robots.txt names no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web. Site runs on Shopline; category URLs are /c-<id>-<slug>. TREE: the React mega-menu is absent from served HTML, so the '2025-2026 Z Gallerie Meganav' object was extracted from /cdn/shop/s/prod/tjperw496xd1uzoe/public/static/zg_bundle.common.js and parsed to JSON. It was cross-checked against the site's own on-page sub-category carousel (the <zg-subcategory data-subcategory=...> attribute, which carries filter.v.taxonomy child nodes) on every furniture department page, and against sitemap_collections_1.xml (559 collection URLs, grepped for every furniture slug incl. kid/nursery/crib/mattress/wardrobe/vanity - none exist). Site taxonomy: Furniture (487) > New Furniture / Living Room (289) / Dining Room (127) / Bedroom (114) / Custom Furniture (45) / Home Office Furniture (15) / Entryway (50) / Outdoor Furniture (29). QTY: the rendered header 'N items' in div.facets-count. VERIFICATION - every one of the 20 leaves was enumerated to exhaustion with ?page_num=N (page size 48) and the unique data-product-id tile set equalled the header exactly (20/20, e.g. Sectionals 59 tiles across 2 pages = header 59). The same headers were re-read in a second pass with zero drift. Independent cross-check: opening each department's own taxonomy filter URL (e.g. /c-319-living-room?filter.v.taxonomy=7079206906280063317) returned exactly the same count as the dedicated collection page for all 21 child nodes. Children sum to parent exactly for Dining Room (27+67+5+22+6=127) and Home Office (5+6+4=15); Living Room children union = 288 of 289, Bedroom 111 of 114, whole-Furniture leaf union = 484 of 487. DROPPED AS RE-CUTS (product-ID sets compared, not names): 'Reclining' (/c-2143-reclining-sectionals, 13) - a Living Room taxonomy chip absent from the mega-menu whose 13 IDs are 100% inside Sectionals+Sofas & Loveseats; 'Entryway' (/c-2356-entryway-furniture, 50) - 100% inside the recorded leaves (console tables + benches + sideboards + dressers); 'Custom Furniture' (/c-2140-custom-furniture, 45) - 100% inside the recorded leaves, a made-to-order flag; 'Cabinets & Shelving' (/c-965-cabinets-shelving, 43) - legacy collection absent from nav and taxonomy, 100% inside the recorded leaves; 'Rectangular Tables' (13) and 'Round & Oval Tables' (12) - table-shape facets under Dining Tables; 'Extenable & Functional Tables' (/c-2152, 1), 'Swivel Chairs' (/c-2146, 13) and the duplicate '/c-2145-accent-chairs' (13) - orphaned legacy collections not reachable from the nav or the taxonomy chips, and partly stale. 'Bar Stools' (/c-76-bar-stools) is live but returns 0 items, so no row. EXCLUDED PER BRIEF: New Furniture / New Living Room-Dining-Bedroom-Office-Outdoor Furniture, In-Stock filter links, Furniture Sale, Clearance Furniture, Best Selling Furniture, all /clp- collection and buying-guide landing pages (Sofa & Sectional Collections, Dining/Bedroom Collections, Stria/Mirrored/Glimmer/Velvet/Lacquered furniture collections, ~150 room-set 'shop the look' collections), Shop By Room /inspiration pages, Free Fabric Swatches (/c-2256-swatch), and the whole Decor / Art & Mirrors / Lighting / Rugs / Pillows & Throws / Bedding & Curtains / Tableware / Gifts / Holiday departments (no furniture nodes in any of them - the DECOR mega-menu was dumped in full and checked). Product-type tallies (data-product-type) were read on the less obvious nodes: Outdoor Furniture is 29/29 'Furniture > ...' items (sofas, accent/dining tables, dining chairs, benches); Bookcases is 4/4 'Furniture > Office Furniture > Workspace Tables'; Benches & Ottomans and Bedroom Benches & Stools are 100% 'Furniture > Benches'. No mattresses, no kids/nursery furniture and no bathroom vanities exist on this site.
